hero.badge: Every milestone deserves to be remembered
hero.titleSub: They deserve more than a folder.
hero.description: Milestis turns your most meaningful moments into living digital experiences — beautiful, permanent, and ready to share in minutes.

soul.title: Why we built Milestis
soul.description: The people we love grow up, move away, get married. Life moves fast — and the moments that define us keep slipping into unorganized photo libraries, never to be properly honored.
soul.quote: Some moments are too good to live only in your camera roll.

stunning.title: Always looks stunning
stunning.description: You pick the photos. We handle the rest. Layouts, typography, light — everything is crafted so the result is always beautiful, whoever made it.

gift.title: A gift worth sending
gift.description: Share a link — and they open an interactive photobook with depth effects, animations and your personal story. On any phone, instantly.

simplicity.title: Made for real life
simplicity.subtitle: You shouldn't need a designer to honor a memory.

speed.title: 5 minutes, start to finish
speed.description: Upload your photos, pick a palette, hit publish. That's it. No tutorials, no learning curve — just your milestone, ready to share.

unbreakable.title: Design you can't break
unbreakable.description: Rigid layouts, curated palettes, professional depth effects. You customize the content — the quality is already guaranteed.

mobile.title: From your phone
mobile.description: Build and publish entirely from your smartphone. At the venue, on the way home, wherever the moment finds you.

cta.title: Some moments only happen once.
cta.description: Make them permanent. Make them beautiful. Start your first milestone today.
